t: 一场大地震袭击了叙利亚,哈马和沙伊扎尔等城镇以及安提奥克的克拉克-德谢瓦利耶斯和圣彼得大教堂等…
te: A major earthquake hits Syria, badly damaging towns such as Hama and Shaizar and structures such as the Krak des Cheval…
dz: 一场大地震袭击了叙利亚,哈马和沙伊扎尔等城镇以及安提奥克的克拉克-德谢瓦利耶斯和圣彼得大教堂等建筑受到严重破坏.
de: A major earthquake hits Syria, badly damaging towns such as Hama and Shaizar and structures such as the Krak des Chevaliers and the cathedral of St. Peter in Antioch.

t: 都柏林王国倒向了盎格鲁-诺尔曼入侵者.
te: The Kingdom of Dublin falls to Anglo-Norman invaders.
dz: 盎格鲁-诺尔曼入侵爱尔兰:都柏林王国倒向了盎格鲁-诺尔曼入侵者.
de: Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland: The Kingdom of Dublin falls to Anglo-Norman invaders.

te: Thomas Becket, Archbishop of Canterbury, is assassinated inside Canterbury Cathedral by followers of King Henry II; he …
dz: 坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·贝克特被亨利二世国王的追随者刺杀入坎特伯雷大教堂;他随后成为圣公会和天主教会的圣人和烈士.
de: Thomas Becket, Archbishop of Canterbury, is assassinated inside Canterbury Cathedral by followers of King Henry II; he subsequently becomes a saint and martyr in the Anglican Communion and the Catholic Church.
